title: 45 minutes for one pair of trousers | Protocol 002
description:
Valdemar Anunciação, Senior Solutions Consultant, presents an English trouser press with aeronautical inspiration and 45 minutes of patience.

You didn't need it. Until now.

— About this video —
The salesman and his colleague are fictional characters. The product is real: Corby electric trouser press (Corby Trouser Press 7700 / Executive). Corby of Windsor.
Not an advertisement: no sponsorship and no relationship with any manufacturer or shop mentioned. Photos are freely licensed and credited below.
Factual information about the product was checked against the sources below on 11 Oct 2026.
Price checked: GBP 189.60 on 11 Oct 2026 (Corby of Windsor). Prices change.
